Subject: Grafana Cloud retention add-on — renewal notice and Q4 offer

Hi Stephanie / Laura,

Hope you both are well. Grafana Cloud shows your retention add-on and extended logs bundle scheduled to renew on 2026-12-12. I wanted to share the renewal pricing and a limited Q4 promotional credit we have for multi-product customers (details attached).

Key points:
- Current config: 90-day retention + 30 days cold storage (approx. 28TB/mo).
- Grafana Q4 offer: 15% off list for a 12-month commit on the retention add-on + waived ingestion fees for the first two months (see attached).
- Upgrade path: we can tier to 365-day retention but the unit cost rises; we have a hybrid cold-tiering plan that may reduce spend by caching hot writes for 14 days.

Attachment: Grafana_Pricing_Offer_Q4.pdf (pricing sheet, terms summary).

If useful, I can schedule a 30-min call next week with our pricing lead to walk through the numbers. Please let me know your preferred time.

Thanks,

Team — looping you in to kick off a quick internal assessment. Priya just shared the renewal offer for Grafana retention. I pulled the usage numbers and monthly egress/ingest estimates into the renewal matrix (attached). High-level asks:

1) Can we reduce retention to 60 days for non-security logs and move high-value traces to Sentry long-term?
2) What is the impact on incident forensics if we cut cold storage?
3) Legal/procurement: do we want to negotiate a 12-month commit vs. quarterly?

Action items:
- David: assess query performance and SLO impact of trimming cold retention to 30 days for app logs (due Wed).
- Markus: run a cost delta for 60d vs 365d with Grafana pricing table (due Thu).
- Monica: start procurement timeline and confirm approval path for a >$200k commit.

I also want to coordinate with Sentry to confirm their retention add-on pricing for traces/errors if we shift more to them. Priya — is there flexibility on a staged increase (60d -> 180d) if we commit to a 12-month contract?

Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Grafana Cloud retention add-on — renewal notice and Q4 offer

Stephanie / team — did a quick pass on likely operational impacts. Notes below:

- Reducing to 60 days for standard app logs: low risk for routine debugging but we will lose long-tail investigation context for intermittent incidents (we commonly rely on 90+ day traces for two recurring infra patterns).
- Cold storage removal affects our ability to run month-over-month trend analysis on error spikes; storage compression on our side helps but not enough to save >10TB/mo.
- Query performance: moving more to Sentry for traces will increase cross-system joins. We should budget 1–2% additional latency in alert evaluation during migration windows.

Questions for Grafana (Priya):
1) Can Grafana provide a monthly export of cold-tiered raw logs in NDJSON for our S3 staging (we'd like a 7-day overlap during cutover)?
2) If we agree to a 12-month commit, can the ingestion-waive be extended to 3 months to help offset cutover costs?

I've attached a short test plan for validating the staging export and a conservative cost delta. Happy to review together.

-David
David Kim
Senior Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: grafana-staging-export-testplan.txt]

Hi Stephanie / David,

Thanks for the detailed notes — appreciate the test plan. Answers inline and a revised offer attached.

- Export: we can provide an automated monthly cold-tier export in NDJSON to your S3 with a 7-day overlap during cutover; we will set up a lifecycle rule to expire exports after your desired retention.
- Ingestion waiver: we can extend the waived ingestion to 3 months if we get a 12-month commit at the proposed volume.
- Staged retention: we can agree to staged increases (60 -> 180 -> 365) with pricing locked at the 60d rate for the first 90 days while you validate.

I've attached the v2 pricing sheet and marked the areas we can concession. If you confirm the 12-month commit by 2026-11-20, I can route to our legal to issue an SOW with those terms.

Attachment: Grafana_Pricing_Offer_Q4_v2.pdf

Best,
Priya Rao

Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Final renewal path recommendation and contract request (Grafana + Sentry)

Priya / Elena / Nick — thanks for the quick back-and-forth. After internal review we have a recommended path and a request for next steps: 

Recommendation (short):
- Commit to Grafana 12-month retention add-on at the 60-day tier with staged bump to 180d after 90 days (as outlined in your v2 offer). Accept the 3-month ingestion waiver if Legal signs the SOW by 2026-11-20.
- For long-tail trace retention and application error history, we will expand Sentry retention add-on for critical services (payment, auth, search) — request Sentry addendum and pricing.
- Split archive responsibilities: Grafana will serve log search & metrics + short-term cold storage; Sentry will be primary for error-trace retention beyond 60 days. This reduces our projected spend by ~18% vs. a sole Grafana 365d commit while preserving post-incident forensics for high-value flows.

Requests / asks:
1) Priya: please share the draft SOW with the staged retention language and the 3-month ingestion waiver; include the export schedule to S3 and lifecycle rules in Annex A.
2) Elena: please provide the Sentry retention addendum and a ballpark for 12-month committed pricing for selected services (we will share the list of critical services in a follow-up email).
3) Procurement: Monica / Laura / Markus, can you confirm internal approval path and whether we can get legal sign-off by 2026-11-20 to capture the waiver?

Attachments: redwood-ma-renewal-matrix.xlsx, Sentry_Retention_Addendum_v2.docx

If we can get the SOW + Sentry addendum in the next 72 hours, I'll route both to Legal for expedited review. Priya — if you'd like, we can do a 30-minute legal + procurement sync tomorrow morning.

Thanks all,
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
